target_customer: B2B software startups handling customer support in Slack, Discord and email
problem: Support teams juggle tickets across chat and email; Clad triages messages, investigates root causes and drafts resolutions for human approval.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI support agent; pricing not stated

founders.name: Richard Wang
founders.background_notes: YC bio also mentions building adtech in AI native

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent that integrates Slack, email, Stripe, GitHub and Linear, investigates tickets and drafts replies; standard LLM agent engineering with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded category; the site shows integrations and a knowledge base that builds from resolved tickets but nothing hard to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Search results show established AI support products with Slack agents; Intercom, renamed Fin, was reported acquired by Salesforce in September 2026. No action against Clad found.

market_need_then: B2B support moving to Slack and Discord is a visible trend and several vendors sell Slack native AI support; Clad site cites a testimonial from Aside saying it dropped Intercom.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and direct tagline AI support done right

branding.community_and_virality: The company first drew press attention as Clad Labs for Chad, a brainrot IDE covered by TechCrunch in November 2025 and debated widely online.

brand_strength.rationale: The Chad IDE launch got wide press and online debate, but the current support product has little visible brand pull. The name Clad collides with an unrelated YC W23 company and other products.

pivots.from: Chad, an AI coding IDE with entertainment and gambling features (Fall 2025 launch coverage)
pivots.to: AI customer support agent (current site and YC description)

outcome_analysis: Clad Labs entered Fall 2025 with a widely covered but controversial brainrot IDE and now presents an AI support agent. The date and reason for the shift are not public. No funding, traction beyond customer logos, or outcome is confirmed, so it is too early to assign factors.
notes: VCBacked and Employbl list 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator (Dec 2025); same data lineage, unverified, not recorded as a round. Competitor search surfaced only 2026 vendor pages, so none are listed; Chad IDE era competitors were not researched. Clad (YC W23) and Clado are unrelated companies.
